scenario.zh: 输入任务需求和资源状态，Navigator平台生成协调方案和优先级建议
scenario.en: Input mission requirements and resource status; Navigator generates coordination plan and priority recommendations

instruction.zh: 选择需要协调的后勤任务

output.zh: 识别维护需求和部署优先级
output.en: Identifies maintenance needs and deployment priorities

input.zh: 15辆运输车辆，3辆需要轮胎更换，2辆引擎故障，5辆油量不足，任务要求48小时内出动12辆
input.en: 15 transport vehicles, 3 need tire replacement, 2 engine failures, 5 low fuel, mission requires 12 ready in 48 hours

output.zh: 立即处理：2辆引擎故障送维修站；优先加油5辆并完成检查；延后轮胎更换至任务后
output.en: Immediate: send 2 engine failures to shop; priority fuel 5 vehicles and inspect; defer tire replacement until post-mission

detail.zh: 引擎维修预计36小时，需确认备用车辆可用性
detail.en: Engine repair estimated 36 hours; confirm backup availability

detail.zh: 调配3名技师至加油和检查任务
detail.en: Assign 3 technicians to fueling and inspection

output.zh: 规划补给路线和交付顺序
output.en: Plans resupply routes and delivery sequence

input.zh: 前线3个医疗站，A站急需血浆和抗生素，B站需常规补给，C站库存充足但缺少运输能力，仓库有2架直升机和4辆卡车
input.en: 3 forward medical stations: A needs urgent plasma and antibiotics, B needs routine resupply, C well-stocked but lacks transport, warehouse has 2 helicopters and 4 trucks

output.zh: 直升机1优先A站紧急物资；卡车队向B站运送常规补给；直升机2将C站多余物资转运至A站
output.en: Helicopter 1 priority to Station A urgent items; truck convoy routine resupply to B; Helicopter 2 redistribute excess from C to A

detail.zh: A站血浆需求12小时内到达，直升机飞行时间90分钟
detail.en: Station A plasma needed within 12 hours; helicopter flight 90 minutes

detail.zh: 若天气恶化，地面车队备用路线增加4小时
detail.en: If weather deteriorates, ground convoy alternate adds 4 hours

takeaway.zh: 示例展示Navigator如何根据资源和约束生成后勤协调建议；实际平台功能和军方部署细节需在官方渠道验证
takeaway.en: Examples show how Navigator generates logistics coordination from resources and constraints; actual platform capabilities and military deployment require verification through official channels
